title: SvgMarker
responsibility: Renders the native marker element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgMarker.attributes
inputs.description: Native marker attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgMarker.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native marker element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgMarker
outputs.description: The actual native marker element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
